primary_source_citation.title: IADMS Dynamic Warm-Up, Sprung Floor & Biomechanics Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Perform 10 to 15 minutes of cardio and dynamic joint-mobility warm-ups to raise core muscle temperature before dancing.
core_mechanism_bullets: Perform 10 to 15 minutes of cardio and dynamic joint-mobility warm-ups to raise core muscle temperature before dancing.
Dance on sprung hardwood or marley floors and align the kneecap over the second toe during plies and jump landings.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Landing a jump through a sequential toe-ball-heel roll with knees tracking over the second toe reduces peak vertical ground reaction force by 35 percent.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Lead three distinct warm-up sequences targeting ankle proprioception, hip mobility, and core alignment while checking knee-over-toe tracking.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: IADMS Dynamic Warm-Up, Sprung Floor & Biomechanics Standard: Perform 10 to 15 minutes of cardio and dynamic joint-mobility warm-ups to raise core muscle temperature before dancing. Dance on sprung hardwood or marley floors and align the kneecap over the second toe during plies and jump landings.
